proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ _
  have hC := LieIdeal.isCompl_killingCompl (LieAlgebra.derivedSeries K L 1)
  have hbot : (LieAlgebra.derivedSeries K L 1).killingCompl = ⊥ := by
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    rw [LieIdeal.mem_killingCompl] at hx
    have hcen : x ∈ LieAlgebra.center K L := by
      rw [LieModule.mem_maxTrivSubmodule]
      intro u
      rw [← lie_skew, neg_eq_zero]
      apply (LieAlgebra.IsKilling.killingForm_nondegenerate K L).1
      intro v
      rw [LieModule.traceForm_apply_lie_apply K L L x u v, LieModule.traceForm_comm]
      refine hx _ ?_
      simp only [LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_zero]
      exact LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie (LieSubmodule.mem_top u) (LieSubmodule.mem_top v)
    rwa [LieAlgebra.center_eq_bot K L] at hcen
  have h := hC.sup_eq_top
  rwa [hbot, sup_bot_eq] at h
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (L : Type*) [Field K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [LieAlgebra.IsKilling K L], LieAlgebra.derivedSeries K L 1 = ⊤
